boundedNextIncrement.scope: Narrow documentation and actual-caller native evidence. Preserve existing in-memory session-only updates, synchronous close, truthful failed reset and v1 isolated-storage contract.
steps: Correct README to state browser storage, session-only warning in Settings, reset-only saved configuration and surviving caches/provider records; distinguish writable partition from denied write.
Use one disposable native same-origin widget and iframe with controlled storage installed before load; seed saved London through production saveLocal, then deny setItem/removeItem.

Use actual buttons/Escape/Tab/close/reopen; retain live CONFIG and exact saved bytes before any prayer await, success-after-failure, reset pending/fail/success with save:false and unrelated sentinels.
Capture closed! opener and readable reopened status, header/footer/card crops and focus/keyboard readback; bind source/browser/platform/fixtures; avoid claims about actual third-party privacy policy.
boundedNextIncrement.acceptance: Documentation truthful; save failure keeps live choice/old bytes and clear warning; failed reset never detects/replaces/claims cleared; successful operations clear warning; native feedback fits and focus works.
boundedNextIncrement.missingCheckRequest: Primary-exclusive native widget+iframe storage-denial caller bridge. Existing tests/r0023-native.html widget wrapper is also inapplicable to six-script root; use a bounded current fixture or repair audit fixture applicability before relying on it.

rollbackOrContainment: Preserve completed source and all stored owner data. Next increment is proposed only; evidence fixture/README edits must remain narrow. On reproduced defect, retain failing case and stop for primary scope/owner review rather than broaden repair.
externalEffects: None by worker: no browser/build/solver/source mutation/commit/push/GitHub comment/closure/deployment. Primary controls reconciliation/publication.
